notes.title: FACE LOVE: Face Designer coming to Steam for FREE
notes.content:
SURPRISE! Our character-builder game FACE LOVE is coming to Steam for FREE!

There's tons of new features, like creative mode, character renaming, and OVER 200+ FACE PARTS TO BUILD YOUR PERFECT FREAK!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960524/ed8fd67269fec66313c188609ac00c8a17f83f4a.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401050/FACE_LOVE_Face_Designer/


It's matchmaking meets sticker-book! Read the Love Profiles of your poor faceless customers, then use random wacky facial-features to assemble the perfect mug for each one!

No winning or losing- just some creative cosmology for these lonesome lovebirds. 

You can save your faces to the Library, and edit them in the brand new Creative Mode. Use the in-game photobooth to take screenshots to share with friends!

FACE LOVE releases on March 5. Wishlist today!!

notes.title: Patch 2024.11.25 01
notes.content:
Patch 2024.11.25 01

Changes:

Adds keyboard controls for cycling the inventory selection

notes.title: Patch 2024.11.21 01
notes.content:
Patch 2024.11.21 01

Bugfixes:

(HOPEFULLY) fixes a bug where the game could save if you quit during a cutscene; resulting in some strangely locked save files
Fixes a bug where achievements for meeting gods were not unlocking properly
Fixes a bug where Alexei would eat 5 posters and then manifest a beach ball, softlocking in early BuzzHuzz
Fixes a bug where dialogue and items could be launched during the final God Complex scene, making Inspekta appear out of nowhere
Fixes a but where shooting dialogue at Inspekta at the end of his first conversation would make him loop back very far in the conversation
Minor typo in finale

notes.title: God Dialogue Sucking Hotfix (Patch 2024.11.16 02)
notes.content:
Hey Grovetenders!

We just pushed a hotfix to allow players to progress who weren't able to suck up dialogue from gods. Those players would fully suck up dialogue, but it wouldn't appear up in their inventory and the god would keep talking.

The bug should be much tamer for now- the inventory not popping up when you suck up dialogue from gods, even though the dialogue was successfully sucked up.

Let us know if this fix works!!

notes.title: Patch 2024.11.16 01
notes.content:
Patch 2024.11.16 01

Bugfixes:

Robart no longer eats the beach ball
Fixes a bug where you could speak to Inspekta twice after completing Milldread
Fixes a bug where asking Bayker for something heavy late in Milldread would revert his state
Fixes a bug where telling P "BETRAYEULTRY" late in BuzzHuzz would make him put his bucket helmet back on
Fixes a bug where telling an actor in Hobbyhoo with "ACTION" after the performance was already completed would freeze the game
Makes one crow immortal

notes.title: Patch 2024.11.15 03
notes.content:
Patch 2024.11.15 03

Bugfixes:

Quitting during [spoiler]a battle[/spoiler] no longer creates a locked save file
Firing Bella's happy line at Kondle late in HobbyHoo no longer reverts his state
